rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides a complete food ordering system for TGO Yemek (Turkish food delivery service) with both local and remote deployment options. The implementation features OAuth 2.0 authentication, encrypted credential storage, and multi-user session management through Cloudflare Workers, enabling secure access from Claude.ai web interface. It supports the full ordering workflow including address management, restaurant browsing, menu exploration, cart operations, payment processing with 3D Secure verification, and order tracking. The remote server architecture handles session isolation and credential encryption at rest, while the local version uses environment variables for single-user scenarios, making it suitable for both personal food ordering automation and multi-tenant deployment scenarios.
